column1: # The components of this repository, by path (README "Versions"; .github/scripts/changes.sh). One
# `<component>\t<pattern>` line each; a pattern is a shell `case` glob over the path from the
# repository's root, in which `*` crosses `/`. The first line that matches a path names its component;
# a path no line matches, and the component `all`, run every job.
# `@core <component>`: the component whose change reaches every other (each plugin is tested over it).
# backend: the program every editor package carries, its protocol, the editors' declarations spec/
# generates, the graph page, and their tests.
# The editor plugins, each tested over the backend of the change it is made against.
# The workflows, the scripts and the pins every job runs with.
